raw_segments.text: Pisannio, I heard no letter from my master since I wrote him Imogen was slain.
T's strange, nor here I from my mistress who did promise to yield me off in tidings.
Neither know I would as betid to cloten but remain perplexed in all.
Wherein I am false I am honest, not true to be true.
These present wars shall find I love my country, even to the note O T H king, or I'll fall
All other doubts, by time let them be cleared.
Fortune brings in some boats that are not steered.
